description: Show or hide a layer at every frame, exactly as the eye in the Layers panel does: sets or clears the layer's `hidden` flag. Its opacity, static or animated, is left as it is, so showing it again restores what it was. Hiding a group hides everything in it. describe_video marks a hidden layer `hidden: true`. Refuses the canvas backdrop.
